verdict.summary: Round 2 resolves both prior findings. The design now consistently states that phases 1–5 wrap the base McpServer, whose GET stream is only a transport-side channel with no production notifications; delivery from SolidMcpServer is explicitly deferred to a separate Solid-over-HTTP authorization/session design, and the phase-4 end-to-end test uses a clearly identified test-double notification source. It also correctly specifies getrandom as a direct optional sparq-mcp dependency while narrowing the supply-chain claim to no new package or version entering Cargo.lock. The endpoint, session, security, replay-bounding, feature-off discipline, and conformance-test plan are coherent for a design-only PR, with no remaining correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security defect apparent in the diff.
